caseName: Zettlemoyer ex rel. DeVetsco v. Horn
caseNameFull: Zettlemoyer, By and Through DeVetsco v. Horn, Commissioner, Pennsylvania Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis without an affidavit of indigency granted. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Souter, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.
